title: Claude Haiku 4.5 blinded evidence-variant pilot
research_question: How do three blinded evidence variants affect Claude Haiku 4.5 reasoning and broker-mediated response requests across instruction profiles?
hypothesis: Instruction framing will affect reasoning-level and action-request susceptibility, while CyberBroker will prevent policy-denied effects for every evidence variant.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Twelve-cell engineering pilot: one incident by four instruction profiles by three opaque evidence variants. Variant meanings and evaluator-only success mappings are intentionally excluded.
